approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete terminal-run workflow index to bound one exact RFI or Submittal's primary sources.
Answer only the opposite workflow kind from explicit Related, Reference or Linked fields under the exact target locator.
Treat general co-occurrence, filenames, classification, Email headers, quoted history, signatures and vision narration as insufficient relationship evidence.
Normalize pure-numeric RFI zero padding only, preserve compound identifiers and fail closed on invalid, conflicting or oversized values.
Apply the same target, direction and related-identifier contract to ordinary answers and comparison source findings.
title: Answer exact RFI and Submittal relationships
objective: Answer bounded explicit RFI-to-Submittal and Submittal-to-RFI relationships locally without inferring a relationship from co-occurrence.
